title: Dutch Pudding with Chewy Jumbo Cookies
description: A classic dessert featuring chewy jumbo cookies paired with a rich dutch pudding.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Whisk together flour, sugar, and unsalted butter until a dough forms.
Roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness. Cut into desired shapes and bake for 12-15 minutes.
While cookies are baking, prepare dutch pudding according to package instructions.
In a separate saucepan, melt jumbo marshmallows over low heat, stirring constantly.
Combine melted marshmallows with dutch pudding mix, stirring until smooth.
Chop chewy chocolate chips and fold into pudding mixture.
Dip cooled cookies into pudding mixture, coating each cookie evenly.
Place coated cookies on a wire rack to set.
Refrigerate cookies for at least 30 minutes before serving.
